vjimc-1998-cat1-01.prompt: Let $a$ and $d$ be two positive integers. Prove that there exists a constant $K$ such that every set of $K$ consecutive elements of the arithmetic progression $\{a+nd\}_{n=1}^\infty$ contains at least one number which is not prime.
vjimc-1998-cat1-01.answer: For a prime $p\nmid d$, any $p$ consecutive terms contain a multiple of $p$; with $K=2p$ there are two distinct multiples of $p$, and at most one of them can equal $p$ itself.

vjimc-1998-cat1-03.prompt: Give an example of a sequence of continuous functions on $\mathbb R$ converging pointwise to $0$ which is not uniformly convergent on any nonempty open set.
vjimc-1998-cat1-03.answer: With a tent $g_n$ of height $1$ on $[0,\frac2n]$ peaking at $\frac1n$ and an enumeration $(r_k)$ of $\mathbb Q$, take $f_n(t)=\sum_{k\ge0}2^{-k}g_n(t-r_k)$: each bump slides into its rational and vanishes pointwise, but $f_n(r_k+\frac1n)\ge2^{-k}$.

vjimc-1998-cat1-04m.prompt:
*(Problem 4-M.)* Prove the inequality
$$\frac{n\pi}4-\frac1{\sqrt{8n}}\le\frac12+\sum_{k=1}^{n-1}\sqrt{1-\frac{k^2}{n^2}}\le\frac{n\pi}4$$
for every integer $n\ge2$.
vjimc-1998-cat1-04m.answer: Compare $\frac1n\left(\frac12+\sum\right)$ with $\frac\pi4=\int_0^1\sqrt{1-x^2}\,dx$: chord trapezoids of the concave quarter-circle lie below it (upper bound), tangent trapezoids at the points $\frac kn$ lie above it (lower bound), with the error coming from the last half-interval.

vjimc-1998-cat1-04i.prompt: *(Problem 4-I.)* Prove that there exists a program in standard Pascal which prints out its own ASCII code. No disk operations are permitted.
vjimc-1998-cat1-04i.answer: Yes: a self-reproducing program (quine). Store the text of the program, except for the string literals, in string constants, and print them twice, once quoted (writing the quote as `chr(39)`) and once plain. Abstractly, this follows from Kleene's recursion theorem.
